outcome: Admission to Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU)
cohort: 9,121 late preterm infants (34-36 weeks of gestation) from 34 participating hospitals.
finding: Late preterm infants suffer from higher neonatal mortality and morbidity, which is associated with multiparity, maternal aging, and the prevalence of inductions of labour and unjustified elective caesareans.
mod_finding: Unjustified elective caesareans are associated with the incidence of late preterm infants and their increased neonatal mortality and morbidity.
